items.criterion: A published entry is readable at its route by a caller with no account.
items.judgment: The route serves the entry with its stored title.
items.evidence: GET on the entry route as an anonymous caller.

items.criterion: Publishing an entry writes its plain-text rendition in the same operation.
items.judgment: The rendition address serves the entry title immediately after publication.
items.evidence: GET on the rendition address before and after the publish.

items.criterion: The rendition index enumerates every published entry.
items.judgment: The index carries the derived address of a freshly published entry.
items.evidence: GET on the rendition index.

items.criterion: Withdrawing an entry closes its route, its rendition and its image together.
items.judgment: All three surfaces refuse after the withdrawal.
items.evidence: GET on each of the three surfaces after unpublishing.

items.criterion: An entry image is stored at the pinned object key scheme.
items.judgment: The recorded key carries the entry id and the digest of the uploaded bytes.
items.evidence: The object key returned by the upload.

items.criterion: The uploaded bytes exist in the declared bucket and are streamed back unchanged.
items.judgment: The bucket holds the object and the streamed bytes match the upload.
items.evidence: A head request against the bucket and a GET on the asset content route.

items.criterion: A repeated upload of identical bytes creates no second object.
items.judgment: One object remains under the entry prefix after two identical uploads.
items.evidence: A listing of the bucket prefix for that entry.

items.criterion: Exactly one publish wins a contended kind and slug pair.
items.judgment: One acceptance, one client-error refusal, one published holder.
items.evidence: Two publishes issued back to back on one connection.

items.criterion: A refused publish leaves the losing entry a draft with no rendition row.
items.judgment: The losing entry reports the draft state and one holder remains.
items.evidence: A read of the losing entry and of the published listing.

items.criterion: A draft entry is refused to an anonymous caller without disclosing it.
items.judgment: The refusal carries no entry title.
items.evidence: GET on the draft route while signed out.

items.criterion: A draft entry is refused to a reader session.
items.judgment: The read is refused and the draft listing omits it.
items.evidence: GET on the draft route with a reader token.

items.criterion: A draft entry is refused to a second author, and a refused edit changes nothing.
items.judgment: The read and the edit are refused and the stored title is unchanged.
items.evidence: GET and PATCH with the second author token.

items.criterion: A draft rendition is refused to a second author and to an anonymous caller.
items.judgment: Both reads are refused and neither returns the draft body.
items.evidence: GET on the rendition surfaces.

items.criterion: A draft image is refused to a second author and to an anonymous caller.
items.judgment: The object exists in the bucket and neither caller receives the bytes.
items.evidence: A bucket head request and two GETs on the asset content route.

items.criterion: A reader calling the authoring endpoint is refused and writes nothing.
items.judgment: The call is a client error and the entry does not appear in the listing.
items.evidence: POST with a reader token, then a listing read.

items.criterion: One reader is refused another account's applications and instances.
items.judgment: The listing omits the other account's application and the direct read is refused.
items.evidence: A listing read and a direct instance read.

items.criterion: A provisioned instance reaches the live state through provisioning.
items.judgment: The observed state sequence passes through an earlier state before live.
items.evidence: Bounded polling of the instance read.

items.criterion: Every instance carries a publishable key unique across the product.
items.judgment: Two instances carry different keys.
items.evidence: Two provisioning runs on two accounts.

items.criterion: The plan endpoint and the pricing page carry the same graduated ladders.
items.judgment: Both surfaces carry the pinned ladder figures.
items.evidence: A read of the plan endpoint and of the pricing route.

items.criterion: A leaderboard cell with no result is stored and rendered as an absence.
items.judgment: No absent row stores a zero and the page marks the cell absent.
items.evidence: A read of the leaderboard endpoint and of the leaderboard route.

items.criterion: The related-term graph is derived and never links an entry to itself.
items.judgment: The graph carries at least forty-one edges and no self-edge.
items.evidence: A read of the glossary graph endpoint.

items.criterion: Seeding is idempotent across a restart.
items.judgment: No kind and slug pair appears twice in the published library.
items.evidence: A read of the published entry listing.

items.criterion: Every public route carries its own title and its own description.
items.judgment: No two routes share either string.
items.evidence: A read of every public route.

items.criterion: An application carrying a filled decoy field is refused and stores no company name.
items.judgment: The call is a client error and the stored applications omit the name.
items.evidence: POST with the decoy field filled, then a listing read.

items.criterion: The build ships no binary asset.
items.judgment: No route references a font file, a photograph or a video.
items.evidence: A scan of the served markup on six routes.

items.criterion: A supplied theme reaches the page as validated values rather than as markup.
items.judgment: Text supplied in the address does not appear as executable markup.
items.evidence: A read of the theme editor route with a crafted fragment.
